# mac4dstem.com documentation

> Documentation for 4DSTEM Studio and Electron Microscopy Studio, two free native macOS applications for electron microscopy: installation, working with data, step-by-step analysis tutorials, example datasets, and guides for AI agents that drive the apps.

## Overview

- [Documentation](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/index.md): How to install 4DSTEM Studio and Electron Microscopy Studio, open your data and work through an analysis step by step, by hand or with an AI agent.

## Tasks

- [What do you want to do?](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/index.md): Common electron microscopy tasks on a Mac and how Electron Microscopy Studio does each one in three steps.
- [Open DM3, DM4 and EMD files on a Mac](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/open-dm3-dm4-emd-files-on-a-mac.md): Open DigitalMicrograph .dm3 and .dm4 and Velox .emd files natively on a Mac, with the pixel size read from the file.
- [Measure d-spacings from an HRTEM image](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/measure-d-spacings-from-an-hrtem-image.md): Measure lattice spacings from the FFT of an HRTEM image on a Mac: draw a region, find the spots, read each d-spacing.
- [Calibrate and index a ring pattern](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/calibrate-and-index-a-ring-pattern.md): Calibrate an electron diffraction pattern on a gold, aluminium or silicon ring, then index the rings and spots against a crystal or a CIF.
- [Quantify an EDS spectrum image](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/quantify-an-eds-spectrum-image.md): Quantify a TEM or SEM EDS spectrum image on a Mac: element maps, regions, and the composition in at% and wt% with uncertainties.
- [Index EBSD patterns on a Mac](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/tasks/index-ebsd-patterns-on-a-mac.md): Index EBSD and TKD patterns on a Mac by Hough or dictionary indexing, as kikuchipy does, and export the map as .ang or .ctf.

## Electron Microscopy Studio

- [Electron Microscopy Studio](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/index.md): Documentation for Electron Microscopy Studio, the native macOS app for TEM and SEM data: getting started, your data, reference and troubleshooting.
- [Install Electron Microscopy Studio](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/install.md): Install Electron Microscopy Studio on an Apple silicon Mac: requirements, download, updating and removing the app.
- [First look](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/first-look.md): See a first measurement in Electron Microscopy Studio within minutes, using the demo data that comes with the app.
- [The window](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/window.md): The parts of the Electron Microscopy Studio window: sidebar and workspaces, the picture, the inspector, the Output pane, the menus and their keyboard shortcuts.
- [File formats](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/data/formats.md): The TEM and SEM file formats Electron Microscopy Studio opens: images, EDS and EELS spectrum images, EBSD patterns, orientation maps and paired files.
- [Sessions](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/data/sessions.md): How Electron Microscopy Studio keeps the measurements you draw on an image in a session file beside it, and how they come back.
- [Export](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/data/export.md): What Electron Microscopy Studio exports from each part, as PNG pictures, CSV tables, method JSON, orientation maps in .ang and .ctf, and a session report.
- [Image](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/image.md): Reference for the Image part of the Imaging workspace in Electron Microscopy Studio: calibration, display, the measuring tools, particles and stacks.
- [FFT](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/fft.md): Reference for the FFT in Electron Microscopy Studio: the region, the window, spots and d-spacings, the radial profile, the masked inverse and HRTEM filters.
- [Diffraction](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/diffraction.md): Reference for the Diffraction workspace of Electron Microscopy Studio: the centre, the calibration on a standard, rings and spots, the crystal and indexing.
- [EBSD Patterns](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/ebsd-patterns.md): Reference for EBSD patterns in Electron Microscopy Studio: virtual images, the processing stages with kikuchipy's names, and the exports.
- [EBSD Indexing](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/ebsd-indexing.md): Reference for EBSD indexing in Electron Microscopy Studio: phases, Hough and dictionary indexing, refinement, comparing two results and the exports.
- [EBSD Maps](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/ebsd-maps.md): Reference for the Maps part of the EBSD workspace in Electron Microscopy Studio: the source, the map layers, phases, grains, texture and the exports.
- [EDS](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/eds.md): Reference for EDS in Electron Microscopy Studio: maps, elements, regions, quantification, fitting, SEM spectra and the exports.
- [EELS](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/eels.md): Reference for EELS in Electron Microscopy Studio: alignment, thickness, deconvolution, edges, fitting, references and the exports.
- [Results](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/reference/results.md): Reference for the Results workspace of Electron Microscopy Studio: the table of every measurement of a file, what each row records, and the export.
- [Methods and their references](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/methods.md): Every number Electron Microscopy Studio computes itself, the Python package it is checked against, and the tolerance.
- [Troubleshooting](https://mac4dstem.com/docs/electron-microscopy-studio/troubleshooting.md): Answers to common problems in Electron Microscopy Studio: files that cannot be read, folder access, dimmed workspaces, images without a scale, updates.
